name: Many to one
idea: Thousands of candidate models narrow, column by column, to the one chip that ships.

name: Two in, one out
idea: The AND gate the model is compiled into: two signals enter the body and leave as one decision.

name: Signal settles
idea: A noisy sensor wave calms and resolves into a single square, the answer on the chip.

name: Smaller, then smaller
idea: Squares nest into one corner, each smaller than the last, down to the smallest chip that does the job.
